info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details Telemetry Notification Configs API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token to specify next page in the result set.

items.docs: Lists all telemetry notification configurations for a customer. Notification configs define which telemetry events trigger push notifications to the specified Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

items.docs: Creates a telemetry notification configuration for a customer. The configuration specifies which telemetry events trigger push notifications and the Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic to deliver them to.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: configId
params.description: Identifier of the notification config to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a telemetry notification configuration for a customer.
